fusions.name: Flung Fruit
fusions.desc: Flings a fruit that deals 4 damage, then bounces to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage.

fusions.name: Branch Swing
fusions.desc: You swing in and strike from range, rushing to the target first and dealing 14 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Vine Hop
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Light Fingers
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you restore 4 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
